name: Crybaby's Gambit
author: Agent15
summary: Every turn, each of your threatened pieces also counts as a capture, firing capture-triggered effects.
description: On each player turn, right after threats are marked, every one of your pieces under threat fires the game's capture event as if it had been captured - the piece stays on the board, but anything that triggers on captures goes off. The author notes a known issue: starting a second game in the same session can leave your pieces unresponsive. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.
